lookForm.heading: Look
lookForm.subtitle: Theme this site. Everything previews instantly below — nothing is live until you save.
lookForm.alertError: Couldn't save Look settings — try again.
lookForm.presetDescription: The starting point nearly every tenant picks. Sets fonts, radius, density, chrome, and voice defaults.
lookForm.accentHueDescription: Only the hue changes — lightness & chroma are fixed (OKLCH), so contrast stays WCAG-verified.
lookForm.logoHueDescription: Tints the wordmark's tonal steps (--logo-1/2/3). Follows the accent hue unless you set it.
lookForm.brandImagesDescription: Stored in Vercel Blob — no on-the-fly transforms, so what you upload is what ships.
lookForm.logoFieldHint: PNG, JPEG, or WebP · falls back to the polygon wordmark
lookForm.faviconFieldHint: Pre-cropped square, please — Blob can't crop it for you. Non-square uploads are rejected.
lookForm.terminalChromeDescription: Window frame + terminal prompt around the site — the single most defining console-vs-editorial switch. Defaults from your preset. Not saved yet — site_config has no column for this field.
lookForm.headingFontDescription: Closed set of five (static next/font loaders). Each renders in its own face.
lookForm.footerNote: Radius scale and density are saved with the rest of this form but don't yet drive the inline preview above.

lookPreview.samplePara: A short dispatch to show heading and body type, accent, logo tones, and radius together.
lookPreview.previewNote: Unsaved form state → CSS custom properties, matching production's OKLCH ramp. Nothing here is live until you save.
lookPreview.fullPagePreviewDescription: Reserved — needs a save to reflect
lookPreview.framePlaceholder: Iframe of the real site in preview mode. Needs a save (or a preview-mode URL) to reflect — space and routing reserved now.

voiceSettings.heading: Voice
voiceSettings.description: The words the site puts in its own mouth. Your preset already sets sensible defaults.
voiceSettings.basicAlert: Nothing required here. Your preset determines the default voice. Most tenants never open the Advanced fields below.
voiceSettings.advancedOverrideInfo: Every field is an override. Leave one blank to inherit the preset's voice-pack value (shown as the placeholder). Clearing a field reverts to the preset default — it does not set the string to empty.
